title: Level Up! AI-Driven Challenges and Adaptations to Code Review Practices
abstract: arXiv:2611.18939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI can write code faster than humans can review, causing a bottleneck and necessitating changes to code review practices. This bottleneck is hotly debated, giving rise to two extreme and orthogonal imagined futures: one where humans continue to be firmly entrenched in the review process, and one where AI agents merge pull requests entirely without human involvement. Yet, these futures remain rooted in folk wisdom. Through a mixed-methods study of interviews ($n = 24$) and a survey ($n = 2{,}590$) at a large, multinational software company with widespread access to AI, we identify AI-driven code review challenges and strategies reported as effective to meet them. We found that AI enables, necessitates, and complicates a shift in the human reviewer's role toward high-level concerns (e.g., design and intent). We found that AI-assisted authoring results in increased burden for reviewers due to challenges such as a lack of author stewardship

translated_title: 升级！AI驱动的代码审查实践挑战与适应
translated_abstract: AI编写代码的速度超过了人类审查代码的速度，造成了瓶颈，并 necessitating 改变代码审查实践。这一瓶颈引发了激烈争论，催生了两种极端且相互正交的想象未来：一种是人类继续牢牢坚守在审查流程中，另一种是AI智能体在完全无需人类参与的情况下合并拉取请求。然而，这些未来图景仍植根于民间经验之谈。我们通过对一家大型跨国软件公司（该公司员工可广泛使用AI）开展混合方法研究——包括访谈（n = 24）和问卷调查（n = 2,590）——识别出了AI驱动的代码审查挑战，以及被认为能有效应对这些挑战的策略。我们发现，AI使人类审查者的角色向高层次关注点（如设计与意图）的转变成为可能、成为必要，同时也使其更加复杂。我们还发现，AI辅助编写代码由于存在作者缺乏尽责管理（author stewardship）等挑战，给审查者带来了更重的负担。
tldr: 通过对大型跨国软件公司2614名开发者的访谈与大规模问卷调查，本研究首次以实证方法揭示了AI时代代码审查面临的核心挑战及有效应对策略，发现AI正推动人类审查者角色向设计与意图等高层次关注转变，同时AI辅助编码因作者缺乏尽责管理而加重了审查负担。
en_tdlr: Through interviews (n=24) and a large-scale survey (n=2,590) at a multinational software company, this study empirically identifies AI-driven code review challenges and effective coping strategies, showing that AI shifts human reviewers toward high-level concerns (e.g., design and intent) while AI-assisted authoring increases reviewer burden due to lack of author stewardship.
